broad_containment_rule: The preliminary reciprocal-parallax cutoff is 1000 / (d_TRAPPIST-1 + 300 ly in parsecs) mas. It only guarantees that the final 300-ly sphere is contained in the download; it is not the final membership criterion.
final_selection_rule: At Gaia DR3 J2016.0, transform each source and TRAPPIST-1 (Gaia DR3 2635476908753563008) from RA, Dec, and reciprocal parallax into ICRS Cartesian parsecs, then retain sources whose Euclidean separation from TRAPPIST-1 is less than or equal to 91.98041813566518 pc.
limitations: This is a reciprocal-parallax display selection, not a probabilistic distance-selected census.
This source catalog records Gaia DR3 positions at J2016.0 and contains no kinematic fields for projection.
Sol is a separately sourced star object from JPL Horizons, not a Gaia DR3 source record.
